# Planview licensing & subscription - what is and is not public (Avantra summary)

## Licensing

Planview solutions are offered as subscriptions. At the time this pack was prepared, Avantra did not hold publicly published price lists, edition matrices or licence-type definitions for Planview products in the knowledge base. Pricing is obtained through a quote from Planview or an authorised partner.

The advisory platform therefore never states prices, discounts, editions or tiers for Planview. Licensing outputs are limited to: which products are in scope, the sizing inputs (headcount by persona) the customer has stated, and the questions that must be answered to obtain a quote.

## Sizing inputs to prepare for a quote

- Number of portfolio managers / PMO users
- Number of project managers
- Number of resource managers
- Number of team members who log time or update work
- Number of executives / occasional viewers
- Integrations required (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, ERP)
- Deployment and data-residency constraints

## Governance

Any partner-confidential licensing material (price books, partner programme terms) must be stored with trust level PartnerVerified and disclosure PartnerConfidential, and must never be shown to customers without approval.
